description: This file defines React components for rendering accessible icon representations of players in a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It includes helper functions, SVG icon components, and a public interface component for use throughout the frontend UI.

methods.name: iconLabelFor
methods.description: Generates an accessible label string for a given player ('X' or 'O').

methods.name: PlayerIcon
methods.description: Main React component that renders an SVG icon corresponding to the specified player ('X' or 'O'), with accessibility features and custom styling.
